select count(*) filter ( where r.status = '예약완료' and r.reservation_date = current_date ) as waitingAuthCount
, count(*) filter ( where r.status = '취소' and r.reservation_date = current_date ) as cancelRequestCount
, count(*) filter ( where r.status = '예약완료' and r.start_time < current_timestamp and r.reservation_date = current_date ) as expectedNoShowCount
, count(*) filter ( where r.status = '인증완료' and r.start_time < current_timestamp and r.reservation_date = current_date ) as delayedStartCount from reservation r
mapper.update: update reservation set status = '취소', canceled_at = current_timestamp, updated_at = current_timestamp where reservation_id = #{reservationId} and status in ('예약완료', '인증완료')
update reservation set status = '노쇼', no_show_at = current_timestamp, updated_at = current_timestamp where reservation_id = #{reservationId} and status in ('예약완료', '인증완료')
update reservation set status = '충전중', updated_at = current_timestamp where reservation_id = #{reservationId} and status = '인증완료'
